note: THE LABS REGISTRY — the declared set of runnable laboratories the /labs page may render.
DECLARED, NOT DISCOVERED, for the same reason as projects.json: a discovery-based generator
publishes whatever happens to be on the disk. Nothing appears on /labs that is not named here.
THREE KINDS OF ENTRY, AND THE PAGE MUST DRAW THEM DIFFERENTLY:
vendored  — the lab's HTML is served BY THIS SITE at /play/<slug>.html. The copy is byte-
identical to a named file at a named commit of a public repository, and
build_labs.cjs FAILS THE BUILD if the served bytes drift from the pinned source
bytes. That is what ties the running lab to the real code: not a promise, a hash.
external  — the lab runs on another site the operator controls. The URL is a DECLARED
destination; this build cannot probe whether it answers right now (liveness is
not a verdict a static export can author), so the page says where it lives and
when that declaration was made, never that it is 'up'.
not_hosted — the lab exists as code and is not deployed anywhere public. It is listed
because a quietly shortened list is how an inventory starts lying. Each entry
names what is missing and why.
THE VENDORED COPIES ARE NOT EDITED, EVER. If a lab needs a fix, the fix lands in the source
repository, is committed there, and the vendor pin is advanced to that commit. Editing the
copy would publish bytes that exist in no repository — unverifiable by anyone.

vendored.title: CBT Module 1 — Surprise
vendored.one_line: The first module of the computer-based course: build your OWN probability from a numberless hunch, then watch two tempting surprise rules die against one demand and earn S(p) = −log p by hand — nothing is handed to you.
vendored.math: Surprisal S(p) = −log p, forced by additivity S(p×q)=S(p)+S(q); units in bits and nats; the learner's own arithmetic lands −ln(0.69)=0.3710636814 on its sealed reference

vendored.title: CBT Module 2 — The wall
vendored.one_line: The true surprise of what you sense is −ln of the evidence — a sum over every hidden cause. Build that sum by hand (it is Module 1's 0.69 all along), then turn the dial and watch the term count explode past any hope of finishing: the wall.
vendored.math: Evidence p(y)=Σ p(y|η)p(η); true surprise −ln p(y); posterior p(η|y)=p(y,η)/p(y); the intractable-evidence (partition-function) wall. Goldens: evidence 0.69, surprisal 0.3710636814, posterior 0.913.

vendored.title: CBT Module 3 — A belief is a position
vendored.one_line: The true belief is behind the wall, so carry one you can move: a position on 0–1. Meet the three pressures on it — fit, stretch, looseness — and prove by your own ranking that no single one is enough (the conflict that forces free energy).
vendored.math: The movable belief q(η) with b=q(η=on)∈[0,1] — a free stand-in, not the true posterior; the three pressures (fit / stretch / looseness) and their conflict. Reuses Module 2's two-cause world (prior 0.7, evidence 0.69, posterior 0.913); no free-energy score drawn yet.

vendored.title: CBT Module 4 — Free energy
vendored.one_line: Three pressures, one number: free energy is the height under a belief — energy minus looseness, fit-and-stretch fused in the joint minus the spread. Assemble it, verify the forbidden evidence sum is nowhere in it, and compute it by hand (F falls from 0.944576 to 0.371064).
vendored.math: F[q]=Σ q(η)[ln q(η) − ln p(y,η)] = energy − entropy = complexity − accuracy; computable from the joint alone, with no evidence term. Reuses Module 2's joints (0.63/0.06). Goldens F(0.5)=0.944576, F(0.913)=min F=0.3710636814. :exact bound tag.

vendored.title: CBT Module 5 — The landscape
vendored.one_line: Free energy over every belief makes a valley. Feel the slope (a log-odds mismatch) blind, drop a ball anywhere, and watch it roll to the floor at b=0.913 — which is the Module 2 posterior. The valley bottom is Bayes, reached without the evidence.
vendored.math: F(b) over b∈[0,1] is a convex valley; slope dF/db = ln(b/(1−b)) − ln(p(y,on)/p(y,off)) = log-odds mismatch; blind gradient descent reaches the floor b=0.913 = the posterior 0.63/0.69. Curve points F(0)=2.813, F(0.5)=0.944576, F(0.913)=0.371064, F(1)=0.462.

vendored.title: CBT Module 6 — The floor you cannot cross
vendored.one_line: Split free energy the other way — F = surprise + gap — and a floor appears: F can never fall below the surprise −ln(0.69)=0.371064. Try to push F below the floor and you can't; the proof is one line (ln x ≤ x−1) drawn above a curve.
vendored.math: F = −ln p(y) + KL(q‖posterior) = surprise + gap, gap ≥ 0 ⇒ F ≥ −ln p(y) = 0.3710636814 (the floor), touched only at the posterior b=0.913; proved by Gibbs' inequality (ln x ≤ x−1). gap(0.5)=0.573512. :exact bound tag.

vendored.title: CBT Module 7 — Minimize free energy
vendored.one_line: The punchline: roll downhill on the one number you can compute and you're handed both things the wall took — the true belief (the posterior 0.913) AND the true surprise (−ln 0.69 = 0.371064), at once. A bound tag keeps it honest: not every F is a safe bound.
vendored.math: argmin F = posterior, min F = −ln p(y) = 0.3710636814 (the surprise); minimizing the computable F = minimizing the gap → 0 at the posterior. Bound tags: :exact (on the floor), :exact_mean_field / :laplace (valid ceilings above), :mmp (can dip below — ln2=0.693147 vs ln2/2=0.346574 — never a bound; MMP-BOUND-01).

vendored.title: Bayes Machine
vendored.one_line: Bayes' theorem as a physical machine: prior chips pour through likelihood gates and what lands in the tray is the posterior.
vendored.math: P(h|e) = P(e|h)P(h) / P(e), run as countable chips rather than symbols

vendored.title: POMDP Machine
vendored.one_line: The discrete-time generative model behind every UNI agent: A, B, C, D matrices you can set by hand, then step and watch beliefs move.
vendored.math: Hidden-state inference and expected free energy over policies in a partially observed Markov decision process

vendored.title: Free-Energy Forge
vendored.one_line: Equation 4.19 taken apart on a bench: every term of variational free energy shown, moved, and re-assembled.
vendored.math: F = E_q[ln q(s) − ln p(o,s)] decomposed into energy and entropy, then into accuracy and complexity

vendored.title: Laplace Tower
vendored.one_line: A predictive-coding hierarchy built floor by floor: prediction errors climb, predictions descend, precision decides who is heard.
vendored.math: Hierarchical Gaussian generative models under the Laplace approximation — precision-weighted prediction error

vendored.title: Jumping Frog
vendored.one_line: The gentlest start here: one frog, two lily pads, and the whole idea of a generative model before any matrix is named.
vendored.math: A two-state, two-observation generative model — the smallest POMDP that can still surprise you

vendored.title: Active Inference Atlas
vendored.one_line: The brain-shaped map: cortical circuits, predictive coding and neuromodulation located on one navigable atlas.
vendored.math: Message passing between cortical layers as belief propagation; neuromodulators as precision control

vendored.title: Anatomy of Inference
vendored.one_line: Figure 5.5 as a working studio: the full perception–action cycle traced through a living diagram.
vendored.math: The perception–action loop of active inference, factor by factor

external.title: Precision Lab
external.source_note: developed in the operator's campus repository (private); the engine is a verified translation of the Workbench's Elixir POMDP engine
external.one_line: Three precision dials — trust in the senses, trust in actions, commitment to a plan — steer a maze agent through visibly different behavioural regimes.
external.math: Power-law precision on A and B matrices; policy temperature in π = σ(−G/T); EFE split into epistemic and pragmatic parts

external.title: Echo Lab
external.one_line: Active inference with echolocation: sensing as an act the agent chooses to spend.
external.math: Epistemic value of an active sensing action vs. its pragmatic cost

external.title: Loop Lab
external.one_line: The math of stuck patterns: how a loop forms, holds, and breaks.
external.math: Bifurcation structure of a belief–action loop under changing precision

external.title: Heart Lab
external.one_line: The long-term cardio-renal loop as a control problem the body is always solving.
external.math: Slow homeostatic regulation as inference over interoceptive states

external.title: Cell Lab
external.one_line: An autopoietic service cell under active-inference test: a system that maintains itself or stops existing.
external.math: Autopoiesis read as existence-preserving free-energy minimisation

external.title: UNI·Sensorium
external.one_line: A program learning to read, one letter at a time — watched live as it happens.
